description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
